text: Marianne, now looking dreadfully white, and unable to stand, sunk into her chair, and Elinor, expecting every moment to see her faint, tried to screen her from the observation of others, while reviving her with lavender water. "Go to him, Elinor," she cried, as soon as she could speak, "and force him to come to me. Tell him I must see him again--must speak to him instantly. I cannot rest--I shall not have a moment's peace till this is explained--some dreadful misapprehension or other. Oh, go to him this moment."
